senses.gloss:
शुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः)
 1. The Indian-fig tree, (Ficus Indica.)
 2. The hog-plum,
(Spondias mangifera.)
 f. (-ङ्गा)
 1. The sheath or calyx of a young
bud.
 2. The waved-leaf fig.
 3. The awn of barley, &c.
 E. शम् to
rest or pacify, aff. गच्; form irr.

शुङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) The Indian-fig tree.
 E. शुङ्ग the calyx of the bud, इनि aff.
